title: Privacy policy
sub: Last updated: June 2026 — CFAO Academy / CFAO Mobility Cameroon
scopeP1: This policy applies to the CFAO Academy website and platform, a CFAO Mobility technical training service in Cameroon (CFAO Group subsidiary), designed and operated by the CFAO Academy team.
scopeBullets: an LMS (Learning Management System) for learner journeys: session registration, content access, progress tracking, assessments and certificates;
a trainer support module for pedagogical or logistical assistance requests from trainers or coordinators;
a training centre room and workshop booking tool (scheduling, capacity, equipment);
the public website (catalogue, sessions, news, contact form).
scopeP3: It describes how your personal data is collected and processed when you browse the site, create an account, follow training, request trainer support or book a room at the centre.
controllerP1: The data controller is CFAO Mobility, whose registered office is in Bonabéri, Industrial Zone, Douala, Cameroon.
controllerP2: CFAO Academy is the operational service. Processing is carried out in line with CFAO Group data protection standards and applicable law (including the GDPR for data subjects in the EEA, and Cameroonian data protection legislation).
controllerCompliance: To exercise your data protection rights, you may also refer to the Compliance / data protection contact details published on
subjectsBullets: Learners — technicians, service advisors, CFAO network managers
Trainers — Key Instructors, Partner Instructor Managers, manufacturer instructors
Branch / centre staff — training coordinators, network contacts, centre administration
Website visitors — catalogue browsing, requests via the contact form
dataIntro: Depending on how you use the platform, we may process:
dataBullets: Identification and contact — name, user ID, work email, phone number, CFAO branch, country, job title
Account and authentication — login credentials, active session history, SSO sign-in (Microsoft, Google) where applicable
LMS journey — session registrations, attendance, progress, assessment results, manufacturer certificates, content viewed
Trainer support — support request content, exchanges with the Academy team, processing status, attachments where provided
Room booking — booked time slots, room or workshop, linked session, number of participants, equipment needs (tools, training vehicles)
Contact form — contact details, subject and message of your request
Browsing and preferences — technical logs (IP address, timestamps), display language (FR/EN), strictly necessary cookies or local storage
dataOutro: Mandatory fields are indicated at collection. Some data may be provided by your branch or network contact when your learner account is created.
tableIntro: The table below summarises the main processing activities. Indicative retention periods may be extended where required by law, litigation or justified archiving (manufacturer certifications).

lmsAccount.detail: creation, authentication, role-based access (learner, trainer, administrator)

trainingPath.detail: registration, learning follow-up, assessments, certificates and certifications

trainerSupport.detail: handling assistance requests, coordination with pedagogical and logistics teams
trainerSupport.retention: 3 years after the request is closed

roomBooking.detail: scheduling at the training centre, allocation of resources (rooms, workshops, equipment)

contactForm.detail: responding to requests (registration, catalogue, partnership, audit)

security.detail: technical logs, fraud prevention, platform maintenance

recipientsIntro: Your data is accessible, within their remit, to:
recipientsBullets: the CFAO Academy team (learning, scheduling, support)
your CFAO branch and network contact
trainers assigned to your sessions or support request
partner manufacturers (Toyota, Mercedes-Benz, BYD, Suzuki, Stellantis, etc.) where certification or the programme requires it
technical subprocessors (Microsoft Azure for hosting, email, SSO authentication) bound by confidentiality and data protection commitments
recipientsOutro: No personal data is sold to third parties. Internal access is limited on a need-to-know basis (learner, trainer, centre coordinator, administrator profiles).
transfersP1: As part of CFAO Group activities in Africa and, where applicable, with providers or entities outside Cameroon or the EEA, some data may be transferred internationally.
transfersP2: Such transfers are governed by appropriate safeguards (standard contractual clauses, adequacy decisions or equivalent measures) in line with CFAO Group standards and applicable law.
rightsIntro: Under applicable law, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
rightsBullets: Right of access — obtain a copy of your data
Right to rectification — correct inaccurate or incomplete data
Right to erasure — under the conditions provided by law
Right to restriction — limit certain processing
Right to object — notably to processing based on legitimate interest
Right to data portability — receive your data in a structured format, where applicable
Withdrawal of consent — where processing is based on your consent
rightsExerciseAfter: stating the subject of your request. Proof of identity may be required for verification.
rightsComplaint: You may also lodge a complaint with the competent data protection authority (Cameroonian authority or, where applicable, the authority in your country of residence, including under the GDPR).
cookiesBullets: Session cookies — secure sign-in to the LMS and booking / support modules
Preference storage — selected language (FR/EN) stored locally in your browser
Technical cookies — security, load balancing, internal navigation (e.g. return to session schedule)
cookiesOutro: Audience measurement tools may be deployed later; if so, your consent will be collected in line with CFAO Group cookie standards. You can manage cookies at any time in your browser settings.
securityP1: CFAO Mobility implements technical and organisational measures suited to the LMS and training data: encrypted communications (HTTPS), role-based access, backups, access control for trainer and booking modules, and awareness for authorised staff.
updatesP1: This policy may be updated to reflect changes to CFAO Academy services (LMS, trainer support, room booking) or CFAO Group regulatory requirements. In the event of a material change, signed-in users may be notified by email or in-platform message.
